parsed.name: quality_momentum_biotech_ai_power
parsed.strategy: Bet on liquid quality-momentum: names with strong 6-12 month price momentum, rising analyst targets (net raises with few or zero lowers), and stable-to-improving gross margins, concentrated in biotech catalysts, AI semis, power/grid, and software. I avoided names far above their 200-day with falling margins and negative revision flow (ALB, VRT, CEG, LEU, OKLO, SMR, FLUT). I would be wrong if a hyperscaler capex digestion headline hits the semis/power sleeve simultaneously, or if several Q4 PDUFAs draw CRLs, or if the momentum factor itself mean-reverts against SPY.
parsed.objective: Maximise 126-session return vs SPY, net of costs, via liquid quality-momentum names with positive revision flow and stable margins.
